verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax has its own API surface for part of the tax posture: registrations can be added through the Tax Registrations API. Nexus insights and transaction reports exist, but the evidence does not show them exposed through the API. An official Stripe MCP server exists, but nothing shows it covers tax posture or that scoped credentials are supported. missing for 10: API/MCP read access to nexus monitoring status, accrued liability, upcoming filing deadlines, documented tax coverage in the MCP server, scoped/restricted credential support for tax operations, hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read my tax posture — nexus status, registrations, accrued liability, upcoming filings — and act on it through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials

citations.quote: add your registrations to Stripe using the Locations tab in the Dashboard or Tax Registrations API
Stripe Tax provides insights about your potential tax registration obligations (called economic nexus in the US).
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
